Host Larry Mizell, Jr. steers the session while Kevin Suggs handles audio engineering and Matt Ogaz nails the mastering. articles.description:
Ghost of Yōtei thrusts you into the boots of Atsu, a vengeance-fueled hero navigating the brutal yet beautiful world of Feudal Japan. The game weaves stark contrasts between serene landscapes and intense combat to drive a gripping revenge narrative.
Atsu’s journey blends emotional weight with striking visuals, making each step toward retribution feel both personal and epic. If you’re drawn to samurai tales soaked in atmosphere and action, Ghost of Yōtei’s story is one hell of a ride.
